$doc: I4b mounted and chariot base characters (8 rotations), styled on H4, one PixelLab character per figure (rider + horse, or crew + horses + car). canvas = PixelLab rotation canvas (square); box = opaque box per game facing (x0..x1, y0..y1 in canvas px); ground = the hooves' or wheels' lowest row; centre = box centre x, the suggested per-row anchor. rotations = local raw path (gitignored); refetch with scripts/art/pixellab/fetch.mjs <character_id> <dir without /zip/...>. Remap palette for the sheets: docs/v5/pixellab/I4a/palette-dark-i4a.json. Scale: same art px per metre as H4 (manifest scale 0.5 like the foot sheets): the riders' heads 9-11 px crown to chin (H4 9-10), the horses' withers about 47 px above the hooves (1.42 m at H4's 58 px = 1.76 m).
approach: one pro-mode humanoid character per mounted figure: create_character mode pro, body_type humanoid (default), style_character_id H4 b7624d6d-132a-458c-8e3d-d6960d175988, view high top-down; size 100 for a rider (128 draws the whole figure 1.3-1.45x H4's scale), 128 for the chariot (its length fills the canvas, crew at H4 scale). Clips: pixminimax 16 frames, keyed loop (start = end = a mid-gallop frame of a first pixminimax run). Rejected: quadruped template horse (smaller pony horse, invented ground shadow, Corinthian-looking helm; its skeleton-v3 template gallop has 8 frames, shrinks the figure and adds ground shadows); create_object_pro_flash (style drift to near-black, scythes and helmet lost).
